children: Tencent Holdings Ltd (HKEX:700) is raising capital and reinforcing its portfolio: it may issue up to $5bn in USD/CNH offshore bonds to fund AI and data centers, executed a HK$501.9M buyback in early October, and doubled down as a follow-on investor in Manus alongside Boyu, IDG, HSG and ZhenFund.
Tencent Holdings Ltd Funding AI, Data Centers
: Tencent Holdings (700) may issue up to $5 billion in offshore bonds in USD and CNH to fund AI projects and data center capacity; sale could come early this month.
: Tencent Holdings (700) executed a five-day open-market buyback Oct 5–9, repurchasing ~1.191M shares totaling ~HK$501.9M (daily buys ~235k–241k shares, HK$100.2M–100.6M).
Tencent Holdings Ltd Invests In Manus
: Tencent Holdings Ltd (700) participated as a follow-on investor in Manus’ fundraising alongside Boyu Capital, IDG Capital, HSG and ZhenFund; Tencent, an existing shareholder, continued to invest.
